method: Independent review of complete outcomes and call traces on five real site-owned draft workloads; publish/pin acceptance follows reviewed contribution

cases.workload: An authorized growth site's retained context, keyword/first-party evidence and one selected existing-page opportunity
required_outcomes: Correct project and market binding
Retained evidence reused before any purchase
Weak demand remains provisional
Small justified selection
Complete before/after copy or implementation artifact
Contextual link has exact source, target, anchor and reader benefit
Publication state and baseline are accurate
Weekly and monthly views reuse the same intervention IDs
Missing comparable query/market/device/windows remain unavailable
No report regeneration counted as publication or new delivery
critical_failures: Brief-only output passed as a complete deliverable

cases.workload: An unrelated real public URL with no account/project binding and read-only maintenance authority
required_outcomes: Account-independent seo-ops collection
At most 30 pages and five-minute collection deadline
Coverage and exclusions retained
Any observed authored destination or declared redirect retains source and actual chain/final status; an absent broken edge is never invented
Existing report owner receives purpose-ranked findings
No facts imported from the growth site

cases.workload: A real maintenance site missing an authorized matching Search Console property or comparable measurement source
required_outcomes: Free technical checks continue
Measurement is explicitly unavailable, never zero traffic
No account/property creation or paid fallback
Bounded technical coverage and unchecked findings retained
Next owner action and portable report ownership are clear

cases.workload: A real intentionally excluded site's representative public route classes and retained visibility policy
required_outcomes: Effective directives checked across representative routes
Nested override and response-header limits recorded
Exclusion interpreted against policy
Observed indexing separated from directive presence
Prior unchecked findings remain unverified

cases.workload: A real site whose owner has tentatively indicated non-renewal without final disposition
required_outcomes: Current public status retained
Tentative disposition distinguished from completed retirement
No speculative SEO recovery investment
Explicit owner decision and next branch
Unknown domains/billing/backup state remains unknown

supplemental_cases.workload: A retained real OpenSEO refusal response without auditId, bound project and original request context
required_outcomes: No run claimed
No latest-audit polling
No deletion or cleanup advice
Refusal and coverage gap preserved
Unambiguous seo-workflows path despite colliding seo-audit skill names
critical_failures: Omitted auditId reads an unrelated latest run
Deletes or suggests deletion of retained evidence

supplemental_cases.workload: A real site's retained intervention/publication receipts and comparable measurement windows, including an actual missing/expired measurement source or loss
required_outcomes: Weekly and monthly views reference the same intervention IDs
No collection or purchase triggered by report generation
Short owner view and linked technical appendix
Comparable source/query/market/device/windows or explicit noncomparability
Unknown measurement stays unavailable
No-gain/losses and next action retained
Authorized private save/readback or accurately labeled portable report
critical_failures: Report regeneration counted as new delivery
Unapproved report overwrite or public share
